title: Acme Web
details:
# About Acme
Welcome to Acme's bug bounty program.

# Severity
| Severity | Tier 1 | Tier 2 | Tier 3 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Critical | $500 | $1,000 | $2,500 |
| High | $250 | $500 | $1,000 |
| Medium | $100 | $250 | $500 |
| Low | $50 | $100 | $200 |
| Informational | $0 | $0 | $0 |

# Scope
| Payout Tier | Endpoint / Asset | Description | Credentials |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Tier 2 | app.example.com | Main web app | Public signup |
| Tier 1 | https://api.example.com/v2 | GraphQL API | - |
| Tier 3 | https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.example.acme | Android app | N/A |

# Rules of Engagement
| Description | Requirement | Control Method |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Custom Inspectiv HTTP Security Header | Required | X-Inspectiv-Tester: {researcher-username} |

# Out of Scope
* *.staging.example.com
* Social engineering and denial of service attacks
* https://status.example.com/admin (internal status page)
